entries.category_description: Live plants and other floricultural products, including bulbs, cotton, roots and the like, cut flowers and ornamental foliage
entries.comment: VAT - Import - Annex 2 of the German VAT Act contains a list of goods falling under the reduced rate of 7% such as live plants, bulbs, roots and so on. For legal certainty please have a look at the German VAT Act.

entries.category_description: Until 1 January 2030: Wood used as firewood
entries.comment: Firewood in logs, stumps, twigs or faggots; wood waste, including sawdust but excluding pellets (CN code 4401 31 00).

Supply of firewood in the form of logs, in billets, in twigs, in faggots or in similar forms, and sawdust and wood waste and scrap, agglomerated in logs, briquettes, pellets or similar forms. See art. 291 para. (2) letters i), j) of the Fiscal Code.
